w3Mentions.name: Spool
w3Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Elena just put down Spool... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

w3Mentions.name: The Terms of Service
w3Mentions.firstLine: 🌙 The cookfire's smell carried further than the laughter did — smoke and grease on the night wind. The Terms of Service is circling the edge of the light. It followed the feast here. (A scavenger, drawn by the feast. Face it while the feast is in you — or let the watch drive it off.)

w5Mentions.name: The Finale
w5Mentions.firstLine: 📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
firstContext: You catch fragments by the fire — Wei telling Claire about you. The details have shifted. Nobody seems to mind.
📺 SYSTEM: "SEASON FINALE APPROACHES! Party cap raised to FIVE! Go out with a BANG! (Figuratively. Mostly.)"
📺 SYSTEM: "CONTEST: The Confession. A villager confesses on camera to poisoning the water store. Prove the confession true or false before dusk — the System punishes someone either way."

auditLine: ◈ THE AUDIT — the System reads your run back to you, and the galaxy listens. A lesser seat — regional standing, waves 1–3 faced (14/10/8), with 6 wave-4 fought, 11 contests survived, 3 crises weathered. The table does not rise. It prices. Ladder — National Standing reached (Fight 3 · Forage 8 · Craft 6 · Talk 11 · Explore 34 → 24 · capped) (+4 feast-bundle bonus)
noticeLines: ◈ THE SYSTEM — "NOTICED. YOUR REGISTER IS SHIFTING TENDER — YOU TEACH MORE THAN YOU TAKE. I AM... KEEPING UP. BARELY. DO NOT SLOW DOWN ON MY ACCOUNT."
ledgerLine: The table has read your ledger. More promises broken than kept; the protected outnumber the killed; the food truth was shared. The light road is open.
finalOutcomeLines: ◈ THE ARCHITECT — Meera Reddy ascended through doors you built: relay. The galaxy will remember the god's name. The village will remember who built the door. Both are true. Neither is small.

gotAwayLines: It got away. No meat, no trophy — but you're breathing, and now you know its moves.
It got away. No meat, no trophy — but you're breathing, and now you know its moves.

ghostLines.line: 🚶 A person, maybe 40s is back with Yara.

ghostHits.line: 🚶 A person, maybe 40s is back with Yara.

firenarr.line: ⚠ The store keeps slipping from its recent high again — evening after evening, lower.
⚠ The store has fallen further still from its recent high.
⚠ The store has fallen far from its recent high again — the shelves are nearly bare.

ladderLines.line: 🍖 THE BUNDLE — no feast tonight, no guests: 8,403 kcal of pantry stores bought the bundle outright. Six different gifts, paid for in food. The ladder counts it.
It wants the job itself: caretaking, as a practice. This is the ask the whole ladder was climbing toward.
